remarks: Welcome to the largest Dalton unit in the sought-after Foxboro complex! This bright and spacious 1,650+sq.ft corner townhouse has a peaceful setting with convenient access to ample parking, a sparkling pool, and a pool house. The updated white kitchen opens to a living room with sliders leading to your private deck, overlooking a serene and secluded hillside. The formal dining room and versatile family room on the main level provide plenty of space for entertaining, with the family room easily adaptable as a first-floor bedroom or home office.  Upstairs, you'll find a generously sized primary suite featuring vaulted ceilings, two walk-in closets, and an expansive en-suite bath. A second bedroom also boasts its own private bath, perfect for guests. The finished basement has a convenient laundry area, abundant space for storage, and room for an exercise setup or home gym. The complex is meticulously maintained and is perfectly located just off Route 7 on the Wilton line. With easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, commuting is a breeze while you enjoy the tranquility of this hidden gem.
